capacity.description: Read, search and convert local documents using the shared frontend WASM engines; select original key excerpts without a language model. Semantic reasoning belongs to the caller.
capacity.details: Filter: --op, --query (keywords or docx>?, ?>pdf), --from, --to. Select: --section/--fields. Details: --full. Empty filtered arrays mean no matches.

cachePolicy: Fresh process per request; OS page caches remain enabled. No application cache eviction or OS-cold claim.
ripgrep:
ripgrep 15.2.0 (rev e89fff89ac)

features:+pcre2
simd(compile):+NEON
simd(runtime):+NEON

PCRE2 10.45 is available (JIT is available)
method: Case-sensitive literal search, complete candidate recall/precision; no semantic ranking. Pre-extraction uses the same FiLens core. Setup includes extraction, writes and measurement artifacts; installation is excluded.
